The only place that knows GitHub: what runs on a pull request, and what its description shows of it.

What belongs here is the workflows, and the gallery: every case rendered, each picture stored once, and the description rewritten to show them all. What a check checks does not belong here, only that it runs, and neither does how a picture is drawn.

Read this pile to find out what a pull request is put through, and what its description shows. Change it when it is decided that a pull request is shown something else, or GitHub changes what a workflow may do.
